title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Arielle Park
description: Context: Private deployments require unattended, auditable key and certificate rotation for long-lived clusters (on-prem and VPC). This PR automates KMS/HSM key rotation and TLS certificate renewal across the private-installer, Helm charts, and Terraform modules. Motivation: remove manual rotation steps, ensure cryptographic best practices (shorter cert lifetimes and automated rollovers), and provide safe rollback for failed rotations. Scope: - Add Terraform module hooks to create and rotate AWS KMS keys and manage Vault transit keys (supports HSM-backed KMS keys) - Extend private-installer to expose rotation policies and a rotation controller that orchestrates vault/sealed-secrets updates and certificate re-issuance - Helm chart changes: add post-upgrade hooks, pre-delete hooks, and an init job to validate current certs and schedule rolling restarts - Sealed Secrets / Vault: automated unseal and re-seal flows + support for vault transit sign/encrypt APIs to handle TLS private key wrapping - Rollout tooling: new CLI commands (redwoodctl rotate-keys, rotate-tls, rollback-rotation) that call the private control-plane operator with dry-run and force flags - Safety: two-phase rotation with staged rollout, automated health checks, and automatic rollback on degraded SLOs - Backward compatibility: defaults preserve current behavior; rotation disabled unless configured and enabled by admin - Tests: e2e test harness updates and unit tests for new controller state transitions Implementation notes: - Terraform: new module modules/kms/ (aws_kms_key resource with rotation and key_rotation_schedule metadata), modules/vault-transit/ (managed key handles for transit engine) and improved variables for hsm_key_id and kms_key_alias - Private-installer: installer/config/rotation.yaml schema additions (rotationWindowDays, rotationStrategy: staged|immediate, vaultTransitMountPath, sealedSecretsNamespace) - Helm charts: charts/private-operator/templates/rotation-controller.yaml with RBAC, chart hooks charts/private-operator/templates/hooks/validate-cert-job.yaml and hooks/restart-on-rotation-hook.yaml - Operator: controllers/rotation_controller.go implements two-phase rotation state machine: Planned -> RotatingKeys -> UpdatingSecrets -> RollingCerts -> Verification -> Complete/Failed. Controller supports dry-run and checkpointing for manual inspection - Sealed Secrets: integration using kubeseal with re-encapsulation via Vault transit; also supports sealed-secrets controller secret rotation using a re-encrypt job - CLI: cmd/redwoodctl/rotate.go implements rotate-keys and rotate-tls with flags --dry-run, --force, --staged, --timeout - Docs: docs/private/rotation.md with migration steps and security considerations Checklist: - [x] Terraform module and example usage - [x] Helm hooks and RBAC entries - [x] Controller state machine and unit tests - [x] CLI commands and acceptance tests - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] Security review and threat model summary Backwards-incompatible changes: none by default; enabling automated rotation modifies secret lifecycles and requires operator access to KMS/Vault. Migration: run redwoodctl rotate-keys --dry-run, verify outputs, then enable rotation in installer config. Related: ENG-1423, SRE-212, SEC-99, SUP-847

release_notes: Automated KMS/HSM key rotation and TLS certificate renewal for private deployments. New Terraform modules (kms, vault-transit), Helm hooks and rotation controller, redwoodctl commands for rotation and rollback, and documented migration steps. Disabled by default; enable in installer config.
notes_for_operators: Run redwoodctl rotate-keys --dry-run to validate key policies. Update installer config with rotationWindowDays and vaultTransitMountPath before enabling. Ensure operator service account has rotation-writer role if you want fully automated updates. Audit logs are emitted under namespace redwood-operator and can be forwarded to customer SIEM.
security_considerations: Rotation requires operator access to KMS/HSM and Vault. We added audit logging, RBAC separation (reader/writer), and HSM key id configuration to avoid accidental exposure. Defaults are conservative (dry-run, reader-only). Ensure KMS key deletion protection is enabled and vault transit keys are configured with appropriate ACLs.
migration_steps:
1) git checkout main && apply example terraform to create KMS/Vault transit keys in a test account
2) Configure installer rotation.yaml with dry-run:true and rotationStrategy:staged
3) Run redwoodctl rotate-keys --dry-run and inspect operator checkpoints
4) Enable rotation by setting dry-run:false and grant rotation-writer to operator SA
5) Monitor metrics (rotation_success_rate, rotation_rollback_count) and logs for 24h
user_impact: Admins that enable automated rotation will see secret and certificate rollouts with zero-downtime rolling restarts when configured for staged rollout. By default there is no user-visible change.
